subject: gk
question: As per the Union Budget of 2021-22, how many textile parks are to be set up in 3 years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seven.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The government has unveiled a scheme for setting up mega textile parks in the country.
 
• Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman made the announcement while presenting the Budget 2021-22 in Parliament.
 
• A scheme of mega-investment textile parks will be launched in addition to the production-linked incentive (PLI) scheme.
 
• 7__ mega textile parks will be launched in 3 years as part of the scheme.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The Union Budget is presented by Union Finance Minister.

 
 
• The union budget comes under Article 112.
 
• The Budget has to be passed by the Lok Sabha before it can come into effect.
 
• The Union Budget is also known as the Annual Financial Statement.
